topic: Outside-window motion preservation and fixed-length inverse kinematics
topic_zh: 窗外动作保留与固定骨长逆运动学
scope: Deterministic local edit masks, two-link pose conformance and Node CPU solving. No Scheduled Inpainting execution, learned motion naturalness, physical safety or GPU/display latency.
